summary: The VV shell of the drawing editor (config, mode controller, tab strip, veil, Dev menu) is 14 mode-controller versions behind TV (1.18.0 against 1.32.0). It is one major tab-strip version behind (1.5.0 against 2.0.0) and 356 key-level config differences behind. Most of the gap is wiring to TV-only subsystems. Four cross-cutting items should land first because they don't depend on any feature: (1) the config pipeline (AppConfig plus the five ConfigState units); (2) the drawing-tab key map; (3) the three-keyboard key scope; (4) the Walk/Fly exit and the quiet document-tab entry, followed by the compact five-tab strip with its Drawings menu. Two live VV bugs were found. First, the key-map fallback has no M, no space=Select and no Ctrl+S (TV fixed this in KeyMap 1.5.0). Second, the 3D hotkeys still fire under drawing tabs: T picks Text and also switches the hidden model to Walk. The 2083-line AppConfig diff is mostly VV's aligned-colon formatting: ignoring whitespace it is 528 insertions and 87 deletions. Of the 356 differences, 188 are TV feature labels and 66 are TV feature keys or blocks; the rest are notes, wording, 16 brand values to keep and a few NA-specific paths. One TV config defect: three labels sit in the wrong block and are dead. VV's lazy loader should stay. It saved about 1.9 MB of start-up JS when it shipped, and parity would grow the editor to TV's 7.8 MB. Every TV-only subsystem is imported only from inside the editor graph, so ports become lazy automatically. What the loader still needs: TV's indexed stylesheets mirrored in order in STYLESHEETS, new facade calls for the strip, a shared-link boot path, and a WaitForFirstDrawing that skips document views and the viewer. The parity ledger contradicts itself on whether the loader is a back-port candidate. The top-bar fold Adam named is already identical in both apps. Ten decisions are listed, led by the Layout Mode switch, the loader back-port, hotkey file names and how the tab strip handles document tabs VV doesn't have yet. Twelve work packages are proposed, with hot files identified.

findings.title: AppConfig JSON: 356 key-level differences, diff inflated by formatting
findings.detail: Key-tree walk of Na__LayoutEditor__AppConfig__.json: 188 TV-only labels, 66 TV-only feature keys/blocks (5 blocks: VectorQuality, ModelSource, PlanDoors, DrawingRegister, Statement), 31 TV notes, 27 doc rewordings, 16 brand values, 13 label rewordings, 8 VV-only labels, 3 value drifts (TitleBlock Rows, scales +200, AccordionSections), 1 VV-only anchor, 3 TV labels misplaced. The 2083-line headline is mostly VV's aligned-colon formatting: -w diff is 528+/87-.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file in two passes: (1) every additive key/block/note/label plus TV's compact formatting now (inert until features land); (2) behaviour-changing values (Rows/DocumentId, AccordionSections, Style FontFamily, the 13 rewordings) with their feature packages. Keep the VV seam allow-list.
findings.evidence: LE/03__Core__Config/Na__LayoutEditor__AppConfig__.json both apps; work_s03a/appcfg_deep.tsv; git diff --no-index -w --stat 528+/87- vs raw 1301+/860-
findings.vv_adaptation: Keep brand values and VV-only labels; VV values for NA paths; do not copy TV's Selection-block labels.

findings.title: Title block config: DocumentId row, ValuePrefix, row width factor, QR cell

VV Rows keep DrawingNumber 'Drawing No.' because that is where a VV number is typed (ledger 339: 'not ported - needs a register').
findings.recommendation: Land ValuePrefix and RowWidthFactorByPaper with the TitleBlock module port; switch DrawingNumber to DocumentId only when the Drawing Register lands; land the QR keys with QrCellEnabled false until D-S03a-06 is decided.
findings.evidence: TV AppConfig:78 Rows, :111 QrCellEnabled; VV ledger :339

findings.title: TV defect: three Measure labels sit in the Selection block and are dead
findings.detail: TV AppConfig puts LayoutEditor__Labels__MeasureOffsetAgain, MeasureNoOffsetSide and MeasureDimOffsetTitle inside LayoutEditor__Selection__Config (lines 367-369). Na__LeCfg__GetLabel reads only the Labels block (ConfigState:372-375), so in TV they never apply and the code fallbacks print. VV has them correctly in Labels (line 881); that is why they show as VV-only.
findings.recommendation: Do not copy the misplacement into VV. Back-port: move the three keys into TV's LayoutEditor__Labels__Config.
findings.evidence: TV Na__LayoutEditor__AppConfig__.json:357,367-369,587; TV ConfigState__.js:372-375; TV Measurements__.js:619,921,925

findings.title: KeyMap unit 1.0.0 vs 1.11.0, with a live fallback bug
findings.detail: Missing: When-context matching (1.8.0, v2.130), ReloadKeyMap (1.5.0, v2.115), copy-drag and move-anchor modifiers (1.6.0/1.10.0), ArrayCharacters (1.7.0), and fallback rows for PgUp/PgDn, K, F6-F9, M, space=Select, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+X, vector and boolean keys. LIVE VV BUG: the fallback has no Tool__Move, Tool__SelectSpace or Edit__Save and enables Edit__Deselect on space (line 91), so a failed key-file load kills M and lets Ctrl+S open the browser Save dialog.
findings.recommendation: Port TV 1.11.0 verbatim (console prefix only) in the same change as the key-file rename (S03a-F08).
findings.evidence: VV ConfigState__KeyMap__.js:63,71-110,91; TV devlog v2.115.0 'The fallback had no Move key'; VV ledger :240

findings.title: Drawing-tab key file: rename to Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json and take TV content atomically
findings.detail: VV Na__LayoutEditor__KeyMappings__.json (36 keyboard bindings, 41 actions) is a strict subset of TV Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json (59/63). TV-only: 23 bindings, 22 actions, ArrayCharacters, CopyDragModifier, MoveAnchorModifier. The internal key prefixes are identical. TV lists Tool__Trim (T, When InContainer) before Tool__Text. Without TV's When-aware matcher, T would resolve to Trim, which VV doesn't handle, so the Text tool would become unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Rename and take TV's content in one change with KeyMap 1.11.0. Update the unit URL (KeyMap:63) and the comment references in Controls__Pc, Controls__TouchScreen, Measurements and AppConfig descriptions.
findings.evidence: work_s03a/keymap_lists.py output; VV SheetTools__Keyboard__.js switch default: return; TV KeyMap 1.5.0 rename

findings.title: Mode controller 1.18.0 vs 1.32.0: the integration hub
findings.detail: VV lacks TV 1.20.0-1.32.0: left-column tabs, floor areas/patterns fold, key scope and document keys, page turning and Walk exit, drawing grid, sheet-keys restart, sheet images, vector tools, drawing axes, note-region grips, quiet document entry, spec lockstep, shared-link options. It also lacks 1.8.0 Model Source and the v2.155.0 viewer path, which has no entry in TV's module log. 828 diff lines. Almost every feature port edits this file.
findings.recommendation: Port in three steps. First the feature-independent hunks (WP-S03a-04). Then one TV hunk per feature package (report table d.1). Then a converge diff that leaves only VV seams S1-S7. Treat the file as HOT.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController__.js log 1.17.0-1.32.0; import walk work_s03a/mc_imports.py (31 TV imports missing or partial in VV)

findings.title: Mode controller VV-only seams to preserve (one is a TV back-port)
findings.detail: IsAvailable/IsLayoutModeOn/SetLayoutMode (327-354), the Enter guard (498) and leave-on-unavailable (777) for Layout Mode; WaitForFirstDrawing (595-600) for the loader; the scene-broadcast listeners that refresh the Viewport panel (866-867, VV 1.15.1); folder numbers 42/43/46 (191, 243-249); Na__LeOsnap__Clear from 30__System__SheetTools/Na__LayoutEditor__Snapping__.js (228).

findings.title: Walk/Fly not left on entry; no sheet-key restart or Page Up/Down turning
findings.detail: VV Enter calls SuspendThreeD() without { returnToOrbit: true } (ModeController:524), and VV Transitions:114 takes no options, so Walk keeps running under the editor (TV 1.23.0, v2.112.0). VV also has no RestartSheetKeys (TV 1.25.0, v2.115.0: detach, ReloadKeyMap, attach, TakeKeyboard) and no StepSheet / STEP_SHEET_EVENT (TV 1.23.0).

findings.evidence: VV ModeController__.js:524; VV 42/Na__DrawView__Transitions__.js:114; TV ModeController__.js:611-617,707,810-819,1219

findings.title: Viewer path: TV never renders a sheet for a reader (v2.155.0)
findings.detail: TV's viewer never calls SetSheet (Enter :752-755; OnSheetsChanged :1131-1138) and fits only in the editor. The change came from v2.155.0 after phones crashed, and has no entry in the module's own log. VV still renders every viewport on the reader's device. Porting it needs the published-documents system (52/53/65 and WebViewer ShowDrawing published).
findings.recommendation: Port with the publishing packages. In the same change, make WaitForFirstDrawing resolve at once in viewer mode; otherwise the loader screen waits about 2.5 s for frames that never appear. Add the missing TV log entry.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController__.js:747-755,1125-1138; TV devlog :1334-1335; VV ModeController__.js:539-542,595-600

findings.title: Tab strip 2.0.0: compact five-tab strip with a Drawings menu
findings.detail: TV: 3D Model | Drawings | Specification | Document Register | Design Statements. Drawings is a menu of every drawing, with the open one marked and a '+ New sheet' row. The strip shows from the 3D view whenever the project has a sheet. There is no rename or drag; arrows step tabs, and landing on Drawings opens a drawing. VV 1.5.0: one tab per sheet plus a + tab, rename and drag, and a spec tab only while a drawing is open.
findings.recommendation: Port through the loader facade (no editor imports). Use Na__LeLoad__IsAvailable for visibility if D-S03a-01 keeps Layout Mode. Render at Initialize, gate the document tabs on feature presence (D-S03a-04), keep fallbacks equal to TV's config wording, and export CloseMenu.
findings.evidence: TV TabStrip__.js:309-374 (render), :421-615 (menu), :626-665; VV TabStrip__.js:182-201,294-354; TV devlog v2.158.0
findings.vv_adaptation: Loader facade imports; IsAvailable visibility; immediate render; feature-gated document tabs

findings.title: Document tabs opened from 3D: VV loader wait would cover the page
findings.detail: TV opens a document tab from 3D via EnterUnder (quiet: no first-open veil over the Register or Statements page, ModeController 1.30.0). VV's WithEditor waits on WaitForFirstDrawing for the active sheet whenever the editor is active, so the loading screen would sit over the requested page until the hidden first sheet draws. This is latent now and becomes live with TabStrip 2.0.0.
findings.recommendation: WaitForFirstDrawing should resolve at once when View is not VIEW_SHEET, or in viewer mode. Port EnterUnder and the Quiet flag in WP-S03a-04.
findings.evidence: TV ModeController__.js:444,733,883-888; VV Loader__.js:376-384,388-422; VV ModeController__.js:595-600

findings.title: Tab strip CSS: Drawings menu rules belong in VV's Boot stylesheet
findings.detail: VV keeps the strip CSS in Styles__Boot because the strip draws before the editor loads. Selector comparison: Boot lacks the 10 TV menu rules (.na-le-tabs__menu*, __caret, __tab--menu-open) and still carries 6 rules TV dropped (__tab--add, __renaming, __renaming-code(+hidden), __renaming .__rename, __rename). Every other strip, arrow and dev-section rule is identical. TV's .na-le-tabs__tab--spec margin rule is dead after 2.0.0.
findings.recommendation: With the strip port, copy TV's menu rules from Styles__Main into VV's Boot CSS. Delete the six dropped rules, and delete the dead --spec rule in both apps.
findings.evidence: TV Styles__Main__.css tab region ~57-260; VV Styles__Boot__.css:33-195; TV Styles__Specification__.css:23-25; TV devlog v2.158.0

findings.title: Loading veil: VV adaptation is right; the first-open wait is narrower
findings.detail: VV 1.0.0 ported TV's coming-out veil and exports DrawingSettled for the loader. It has no FirstOpen, by design, because the loader screen covers going in. Gap: TV's going-in wait also covers the specification and the PDF text metrics, with a status line naming the first outstanding job. VV's PreloadMetrics returns nothing (ModeController 467-475), so nothing can wait on it.
findings.recommendation: Keep the adaptation. Add a VV FirstOpenJobs helper reusing TV's track/Advance/Settled code so WaitForFirstDrawing covers the same three jobs with TV's status lines, and make PreloadMetrics return its promise as TV does (:632-640).
findings.evidence: git diff -w LoadingVeil (234 lines); TV LoadingVeil FirstOpen region; VV ModeController__.js:467-475

findings.title: Loading screen wording differs from TV's veil
findings.detail: VV shows 'Loading Layout Editor...' with 'Fetching the drawing tools' / 'Reading the drawing settings' / 'Drawing the Views - n of m'. TV shows 'Your Drawings Are Loading' with 'Drawing the Views - n of m', 'Reading the Project Specification' and 'Preparing the Drawing Fonts'. The screen can't read the config, because it is up while the config loads.
findings.recommendation: Adopt TV's headline and job lines as hard-coded fallbacks, keeping VV's two pre-load lines first (D-S03a-09).
findings.evidence: VV LoadingScreen__.js:61; VV Loader__.js:144-146; TV LoadingVeil FirstOpen labels

findings.title: Keep the VV lazy loader, with a documented registration pattern
findings.detail: The VV-only LE/01__Core__Loader keeps the editor off start-up. VV v2.45.0 measured start-up JS dropping from 417 files/9.5 MB to 345/7.6 MB, with the editor's share going from 73 files/1.9 MB to 48 KB. Parity grows VV's LE to TV's 289 JS files/7.8 MB plus 23 CSS/418 KB, and TV still imports all of it at start-up (Index.html 901-904). Every TV-only LE subsystem is imported only from inside the LE graph, so they become lazy automatically.
findings.recommendation: Keep (D-S03a-02). Write the rule into the loader header: page code imports only the loader and dependency-free leaves; editor modules only through import() with literal specifiers; TV-indexed CSS goes into STYLESHEETS in order; self-linking CSS needs nothing; pre-load UI goes through the facade.
findings.evidence: VV devlog :2471-2478; tree_tv/tree_vv byte sums; TV Index.html:901-904; import walk of TV-only subfolders

findings.title: Loader STYLESHEETS must mirror TV's CSS-index LE imports
findings.detail: TV's CSS index imports 14 LE sheets (lines 161-174); VV's STYLESHEETS has 8. Still to add as features land: DraftMode, DrawingGrid, ObjectSnap, DrawingAxes (after Main__Paper), then SheetImages and Share (after Spec__Read, before WebViewer). Patterns, FloorAreas, DrawingRegister, ScrapbookSpecification, VectorTools and the Statement CSS link themselves, so they need no entry. ColourPalette and SpellCheck are page-level in TV (182, 190).
findings.recommendation: Each feature package adds its own line in TV's order. Never pre-register a file that doesn't exist yet: a missing file only warns. Add a parity test that reads TV's CSS index.
findings.evidence: TV Na__CoreUi__Styles__Index__.css:161-174,182,190; VV Loader__.js:125-134,264-278; TV Register__Editor__.js:596 self-link

findings.title: Loader facade additions: strip actions, view copies, model source, shared links
findings.detail: TabStrip 2.0.0 needs OpenRegister, OpenStatements, IsSitePlanSheet and the VIEW_REGISTER/VIEW_STATEMENT constants, which VV's strip may reach only through the loader; CheckNames (284-295) must cover them. The Dev menu's live-phase bake needs ModelSource in ImportEditor. TV starts Na__LeShareOpen__Initialize (66 sharing) at boot (Index.html 1733-1738).
findings.recommendation: Add the facade functions and copies; before load, IsSitePlanSheet reads record.Sheet__DrawingType === 'siteplan'. Add a literal modelSource import once ModelSource exists. Add a boot path that runs only when ?open= is present: Require(), then import the share-open module and initialise it.
findings.evidence: TV TabStrip__.js:135-161; VV Loader__.js:244-253,284-295,698-706; TV Index.html:1733-1738; TV SheetRecords__.js:433,1311

findings.title: Ledger contradiction on the loader, plus stale rows

The 20-Sep veil table says 'Not a back-port candidate' (1244). Also stale: 'verification harnesses ... ValeVision has no equivalent' (44-49; VV now has both), the 'whole Layout Editor' pending row (1228), and the VV plan's D22 text and its JSON comment 'the live site ignores it' (plan 70, 242).

findings.title: VV-only Layout Mode switch: keep, retire or back-port
findings.detail: VV-only per-project gate LayoutEditor__DrawingsData__LayoutModeEnabled, off by default: tabs and sheets appear only when it is on and a sheet exists, on localhost and live (VV v2.45.0). TV shows the strip whenever a sheet exists. The switch lives in ProjectData (42), the loader (IsAvailable 503-507), the mode controller (327-354), the Dev menu and three labels.

findings.title: Dev menu: VV holds the newer architecture, TV one newer behaviour
findings.detail: VV 1.4.0 has the newer architecture: loader-aware, Layout Mode switch, opens itself on the click that imported it, and Delete asks before loading. TV 1.3.0 has one newer behaviour, TV 1.2.0's live-phase bake filter (Na__LeSource__Resolve(v).isLive, TV :177). TV's NoSheets fallback (:207) is stale against its own config.

findings.title: Key scope leaf missing in VV
findings.detail: 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js (TV 1.1.0) defines three scopes (model, sheet, document). The mode controller hands over a reader that is asked on every key. The file also provides IsTypingTarget (which counts contenteditable) and ControlKeepsKey. It has no imports. Its consumers are the 3D hotkeys, DocumentKeys, Controls__Pc (127), SheetTools__Keyboard (278) and the mode controller.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim, with the header naming VV's handler and key files. It is page-level (VV's HotkeyHandler imports it), so it adds no loader cost.
findings.evidence: TV 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__KeyScope__.js; grep of importers

findings.title: VV 3D hotkeys answer under drawing tabs (code-path evidence)
findings.detail: VV's HotkeyHandler (53-56, 91-101) has no scope check and no contenteditable test. It and the sheet keyboard (SheetTools:476) both listen on window, and the sheet never checks defaultPrevented. On a drawing tab, T selects Text AND calls SetWalkMode (index.html 1795); R picks Rectangle AND resets the hidden camera; V toggles the carousel. TV v2.110.0 fixed the same report. Not run in a browser.
findings.recommendation: Guard HandleKeyDown with Na__KeyScope__Is(Na__KeyScope__MODEL) and use Na__KeyScope__IsTypingTarget in place of the tag-only test. Keep VV's action names and VV-only actions.
findings.evidence: VV Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__.js:53-56,91-101; VV index.html:1792-1809; VV SheetTools__.js:476; TV devlog v2.110.0

findings.title: 3D hotkey dictionary naming and manager placement
findings.detail: TV uses three per-tab hotkey files: Na__Hotkeys__3dModelTab__.json in 02__AppData, DrawingTabs and DocumentTabs. VV uses Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json, read by 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ValeVision__HotkeyHandler__.js; TV's Hotkeys__Manager (10__NavigationAndCameras) was itself ported from that handler. The array keys (Na__TrueVision__/Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary) and action prefixes are brand-specific.
findings.recommendation: Rename the VV 3D JSON to Na__Hotkeys__3dModelTab__.json and update the fetch path (handler :116). Keep VV's array key, ValeVision__* actions and handler module (D-S03a-03).
findings.evidence: TV KeyScope 1.1.0 log (rename); VV HotkeyHandler__.js:116

findings.title: Document keyboard (31__System__DocumentKeys) missing
